scenes.say: Ever wonder what really keeps user sessions safe? Could your app's sessions get hijacked?

scenes.label: Auth vs Session
scenes.sub: Authentication checks who you are. Session security keeps your access safe after login.
scenes.say: Authentication checks who you are. Session security keeps your access safe after you log in.
Here's what I always do: enforce strong passwords, add multi-factor authentication, use secure cookies, and make sessions expire after inactivity.

scenes.title: Example Cookie Settings
scenes.say: For sessions, set cookies with Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite set to strict. This blocks most hijacking tricks.

scenes.question: What's often missed in session security?
scenes.right: Forgetting to set session expiration leaves sessions open to hijacking.
scenes.say: Here's a common interview trap: many forget to set session expiration. Without it, sessions stay open and can be hijacked.
